result.description: Compact tabletop ambient audio dock designed for lounge counters, hospitality suites, and meditation spaces. Features dual full-range drivers, soft-touch capacitive controls, Bluetooth 5.3 audio input, USB-C power delivery, and a warm white status ring with three scene modes. Tuned for near-field listening rather than gaming or workstation use, with an emphasis on low-profile design and room-filling background sound.
